notes.title: Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
A demo of the beginning part of Frontier Quest is now available to play!

Explore the Frontier, fight enemies in puzzle-oriented combat and collect materials to complete quests and rebuild the frontier town.

We also have a discord server you can join! Feel free to come hang out, chat with the devs and give us your feedback.
And don't forget to add Frontier Quest to your wishlist if you haven't already!
